shelf.title: Everything, side by side
shelf.closedNote: — this is how they sit in the stack
shelf.closedExplainer: Every closed book sits directly under its own cover, resting on one line. Thickness is editorial weight rather than page count — the projects magazine is the thickest because it is what most people come for. Each book faces you spine-first, so the title reads straight off the flat spine.

scratch.title: Scratch route
scratch.intro: Not linked from anywhere — renders every Phase 1 primitive against tokens.ts so drift is visible immediately.

profile.bio: I'm a Frontend-focused Full-Stack Developer with three years of experience building production React and TypeScript applications for B2B and B2C products — from the UI through REST APIs and the PostgreSQL data layer, including authentication and claims-based authorization. I'm especially drawn to AI-powered products, shipping LLM features with validated, predictable output alongside measurable frontend and API performance gains.

resume.title: Resume
resume.blurb: The CV as a typeset object — experience, stack and education set like a printed page rather than an exported PDF. Every line still reads as plain text for a recruiter parser.
